A SKOS vocabulary

PCNN variable vocabulary

Identifiers for questionnaire and demographic columns in the PCNN post-COVID study. Each variable has a persistent IRI. SKOS matches to LOINC, SNOMED CT or NCIt are annotations, not replacements for the PCNN identifier.

Description
The PCNN variable vocabulary is a collection of study variables — one term per codebook column — from questionnaires and study-specific items used in PCNN. For each variable it provides a unique persistent identifier, Dutch and English labels, a shared value set where answers are reused, and where possible a SKOS match to a public vocabulary. Annotating datasets with these IRIs, rather than column names alone, is what makes the data machine-actionable.

1. Collections by instrument

Bell CFIDS Disability Scale (1)

  • BellScore — Circle the number of the statement that best describes your level of physical function

Brief Pain Inventory (BPI) (16)

  • bpi_abnormalpain — Throughout our lives, most of us have pain from time to time (such as minor headaches, sprains, and toothaches). Have you had pain other than these everyday kinds of pain today?
  • bpi_pain_where_front — Indicate your main pain area (front).
  • bpi_pain_where_back — Indicate your main pain area (back).
  • bpi_worstpain — How would you rate your pain at its worst in the last 24 hours?
  • bpi_leastpain — How would you rate your pain at its least in the last 24 hours?
  • bpi_average24hrs — How would you rate your pain in the last 24 hours on the average?
  • bpi_current_pain — How would you rate your pain right now?
  • bpi_pain_rx — What treatments/medications are you receiving for your pain?
  • bpi_pain_release — In the last 24 hours, how much relief have pain treatments of medications provided? Please rate this on a scale from 0-100, where 0% means no relief and 100% means complete relief.
  • bpi_prohibited_activity — How did pain, during the last 24 hours, interfere with your general activity? 0 means no interference, 10 means completely interferes.
  • bpi_prohibited_mood — How did pain, during the last 24 hours, interfere with your mood? 0 means no interference, 10 means completely interferes.
  • bpi_prohibited_walking_ability — How did pain, during the past 24 hours, interfere with your walking ability? 0 means no interference, 10 means completely interferes.
  • bpi_prohibited_daily_work — How did pain, during the past 24 hours, interfere with your normal work (includes both work outside the home and housework)? 0 means no interference, 10 means completely interferes.
  • bpi_prohibited_relations — How did pain, during the past 24 hours, interfere with your relations with other people? 0 means no interference, 10 means completely interferes.
  • bpi_prohibited_sleep — How did pain, during the past 24 hours, interfere with your sleep? 0 means no interference, 10 means completely interferes.
  • bpi_prohibited_enjoyment_of_life — How did pain, during the past 24 hours, interfere with your enjoyment of life? 0 means no interference, 10 means completely interferes.

MESSY - Multi-Modal Evaluation of Sensory Sensitivity (26)

  • MESSY_multisense — Bent u sinds het krijgen van long COVID gevoeliger geworden voor situaties waarin er veel omgevingsprikkels zijn (situaties waarin er veel rondom u gebeurt)? Bijvoorbeeld: in een drukke ruimte waar er veel mensen en veel geluiden zijn, in een supermarkt, wanneer u veel bezoek tegelijkertijd ontvangt
  • MESSY_multisense1 — Hoe of wanneer merkte u dit?
  • MESSY_manypeople — Ik krijg last of ik voel mij overweldigd wanneer er veel mensen om mij heen zijn. Bijvoorbeeld: tijdens een familiefeest, in een treinstation, in een restaurant.
  • MESSY_headache — Ik krijg hoofdpijn als er veel omgevingsprikkels, zoals licht, geluid of geuren, om mij heen zijn. Bijvoorbeeld: tijdens een familiefeest, in een treinstation, in een restaurant.
  • MESSY_tired — Ik word moe als er veel omgevingsprikkels, zoals licht, geluid of geuren, om mij heen zijn. Bijvoorbeeld: tijdens een familiefeest, in een treinstation, in een restaurant.
  • MESSY_focus — Wanneer ik mij probeer te concentreren vind ik het moeilijk om niet afgeleid te raken door storende omgevingsprikkels. Bijvoorbeeld: wanneer ik een gesprek probeer te voeren, vind ik het moeilijk om niet afgeleid te raken door een televisie die aanstaat of door andere mensen die aan het praten zijn.
  • MESSY_hardwork — Ik heb het gevoel dat mijn brein te hard moet werken of mijn hoofd voelt zwaar wanneer ik omgevingsprikkels, zoals licht, geluid of geuren, moet verwerken.
  • MESSY_notquiet — Ik heb het gevoel dat mijn brein niet rustig of stil wordt.
  • MESSY_feverish — Ik krijg een ijl (koortsig) gevoel wanneer er veel omgevingsprikkels, zoals licht, geluid of geuren, om mij heen zijn. Bijvoorbeeld mijn zicht wordt wazig.
  • score_multisensory_sensitivity — Somscore multisensorische gevoeligheid
  • MESSY_visual — Bent u sinds het krijgen van long COVID gevoeliger geworden voor licht, felle kleuren of bewegende beelden? Bijvoorbeeld: snel bewegende beelden op de televisie, wanneer er mensen om u heen bewegen zoals in een drukke therapieruimte of in een restaurant
  • MESSY_visual1 — Hoe of wanneer merkte u dit?
  • MESSY_brightlight — Ik ben gevoelig voor fel licht. Bijvoorbeeld: fel zonlicht, het licht van een felle tl-buis.
  • MESSY_muchtosee — Ik krijg last of ik voel mij overweldigd wanneer er veel om mij heen te zien is. Bijvoorbeeld: wanneer er op de televisie beelden snel voorbij komen, in het verkeer, in een restaurant.
  • MESSY_distractseeing — Ik word afgeleid als er veel om mij heen te zien is. Bijvoorbeeld: wanneer ik een gesprek probeer te voeren in een druk restaurant, tijdens het rijden in de auto, in een supermarkt, wanneer er veel mensen in de buurt zijn.
  • MESSY_movement — Ik vind het vervelend wanneer er veel beweging om mij heen te zien is. Bijvoorbeeld: snel bewegende beelden op te televisie, voorbijkomend verkeer tijdens het rijden in de auto, mensen die zich om mij heen bewegen.
  • MESSY_brightcolour — Ik heb last van felle kleuren. Bijvoorbeeld: een felle kleur verf op de muur, fel gekleurde kleding
  • score_visual_sensitivity — Somscore visuele gevoeligheid
  • MESSY_auditory — Bent u sinds het krijgen van long COVID gevoeliger geworden voor geluid? Bijvoorbeeld: u ervaart geluiden als storend of hinderlijk die andere mensen niet als storend of hinderlijk ervaren.
  • MESSY_auditory1 — Hoe of wanneer merkte u dit?
  • MESSY_annoyed — Ik erger mij aan geluiden die voor andere mensen niet storend zijn. Bijvoorbeeld: verkeer dat langsrijdt, een telefoon die afgaat, een televisie of een radio die aanstaat, het geluid van spelende kinderen, mensen die eten.
  • MESSY_shutoff — Ik probeer geluid buiten te sluiten. Bijvoorbeeld: ik gebruik oordopjes of een koptelefoon, ik sluit mijn oren, ik zet de radio of de televisie zachter of uit
  • MESSY_avoid — Ik blijf weg van rumoerige situaties. Bijvoorbeeld een druk feest, een cafetaria, een treinstation.
  • MESSY_soundsens — Ik ben gevoelig voor geluid. Bijvoorbeeld ik ervaar geluiden als storend of hinderlijk die andere mensen niet als storend of hinderlijk ervaren.
  • MESSY_distractsound — Ik vind het moeilijk om mij te concentreren op een gesprek wanneer er om mij heen omgevingsgeluid is. Bijvoorbeeld ik raak afgeleid door een radio die aanstaat of door de gesprekken van andere mensen.
  • score_auditory_sensitivity — Somscore auditieve gevoeligheid

SF-36 (36)

  • sf36_01 — In general, would you say your health is?
  • sf36_02 — Compared to one year ago, how would you rate your health in general now?
  • sf36_03a — Does your health now limit you in vigorous activities, such as running, lifting heavy objects, participating in strenuous sports?
  • sf36_03b — Does your health now limit you in moderate activities, such as moving a table, pushing a vacuum cleaner, bowling, or playing golf?
  • sf36_03c — Does your health now limit you in lifting or carrying groceries?
  • sf36_03d — Does your health now limit you in climbing several flights of stairs?
  • sf36_03e — Does your health now limit you in climbing one flight of stairs?
  • sf36_03f — Does your health now limit you in bending, kneeling, or stooping?
  • sf36_03g — Does your health now limit you in walking more than a mile?
  • sf36_03h — Does your health now limit you in walking several blocks?
  • sf36_03i — Does your health now limit you in walking one block?
  • sf36_03j — Does your health now limit you in bathing or dressing yourself?
  • sf36_04a — During the past 4 weeks, as a result of your physical health, did you cut down the amount of time you spent on work or other activities?
  • sf36_04b — During the past 4 weeks, as a result of your physical health, did you accomplished less than you would like?
  • sf36_04c — During the past 4 weeks, as a result of your physical health, were you limited in the kind of work or other activities?
  • sf36_04d — During the past 4 weeks, as a result of your physical health, did you have difficulty performing the work or other activities (for example, it took extra effort)?
  • sf36_05a — During the past 4 weeks, as a result of any emotional problems (such as feeling depressed or anxious), did you cut down the amount of time you spent on work or other activities?
  • sf36_05b — During the past 4 weeks, as a result of any emotional problems (such as feeling depressed or anxious), did you cut down the amount of time you spent on work or other activities?
  • sf36_05c — During the past 4 weeks, as a result of any emotional problems (such as feeling depressed or anxious), did you ccomplished less than you would like?
  • sf36_06 — During the past 4 weeks, to what extent has your physical health or emotional problems interfered with your normal social activities with family, friends, neighbors, or groups?
  • sf36_07 — How much bodily pain have you had during the past 4 weeks?
  • sf36_08 — During the past 4 weeks, how much did pain interfere with your normal work (including both work outside the home and housework)?
  • sf36_09a — How much of the time during the past 4 weeks did you feel full of pep?
  • sf36_09b — How much of the time during the past 4 weeks have you been a nervous person?
  • sf36_09c — How much of the time during the past 4 weeks have you felt so down in the dumps that nothing could cheer your up?
  • sf36_09d — How much of the time during the past 4 weeks have you felt calm and peaceful?
  • sf36_09e — How much of the time during the past 4 weeks did you have a lot of energy?
  • sf36_09f — How much of the time during the past 4 weeks have you felt downhearted and blue?
  • sf36_09g — How much of the time during the past 4 weeks did you feel worn out?
  • sf36_09h — How much of the time during the past 4 weeks have you been a happy person?
  • sf36_09i — How much of the time during the past 4 weeks did you feel tired?
  • sf36_10 — During the past 4 weeks, how much of the time has your physical health or emotional problems interfered with your social activities (like visiting with friends, relatives, etc.)?
  • sf36_11a — True or false: I seem to get sick a little easier than other people
  • sf36_11b — True or false: I am as healthy as anybody I know
  • sf36_11c — True or false: I expect my health to get worse
  • sf36_11d — True or false: My health is excellent

no instrument (84)

  • dob — What is your date of birth?
  • age — What is your age?
  • sex — What is your sex as determined at birth ?
  • gender — What description suits you best?
  • residence — In which country do you live?
  • postalcode — What is your postalcode? Fill out the 4 digits and 2 letters of your postalcode
  • countrybirth — I which country were you born?
  • countrybirth_other — I which country were you born?
  • countrybirth_mother — What is the country of birth of your mother?
  • countrybirth_mother_other — What is the country of birth of your mother?
  • countrybirth_father — What is the country of birth of your biological father?
  • countrybirth_father_other — What is the country of birth of your biological father?
  • education — What is your highest education (completed with diploma)?
  • marital_status — What is your marital status?
  • children — Do you have biological children?
  • livingsituation — Which description fits your livingsituation best?
  • pregnant — Are you currently pregnant?
  • pregbrstfeed — Have you been pregnant or breastfed in the past 12 months?
  • self_weight — What is your weight in kg without clothes? If pregnant, fill out your weight before pregnancy.
  • self_weight_precompl — What was your weight in kg before your complaints started? If pregnant, fill out your weight from before pregnancy,
  • self_height — How tall are you? In centimeters and without shoes.
  • self_BMI — BMI based on self reported height and weight (calculation field: kg/m^2)
  • smokingstatus — Do you smoke?
  • paidjob — Do you have a paid job at this moment?
  • employment_status — Which situation applies to you most? / paid work
  • income — How much is your nett income per month? (if you share a household with someone, also include the income of your partner(s))
  • hours_household — Household activities? (hours per week):
  • hours_work — Work related activities? (hours per week):
  • hours_family — Family activities? (hours per week):
  • Number — Social/recreational activities? (hours per week):
  • onbehalf — Do you provide this information for another person?
  • onbehalf_who — What is your relation to the person for whom you provide information?
  • onbehalf_who_t — How are you related?
  • howheardstudy — How did you hear about the post-COVID research?
  • invitation — Which research or organization invited you?
  • studycodept — Enter the research code you received by email or letter here. This allows your data to be linked to the questionnaire data you are now filling in
  • LTcompl_virus — Do you currently have long-term health complaints due to the coronavirus?
  • LTcompl_virus_start — Can you indicate when these long-term complaints due to the coronavirus approximately started? You may also estimate the date.
  • LTcompl_virus_recover — Can you indicate when you recovered from your long-term health complaints due to coronavirus? You may also estimate the date.
  • LTcompl_vacc — Do you currently have long-term health problems due to a coronavirus vaccination? You may also estimate the date.
  • LTcompl_vacc_start — Can you indicate when these long-term complaints from a coronavirus vaccination approximately started? You may also estimate the date.
  • LTcompl_vacc_recover — Can you indicate when you recovered from your long-term health complaints due to the corona vaccine? You may also estimate the date.
  • Nxinfected — How often do you think you have been infected with the coronavirus since the start of the pandemic in the Netherlands (February 2020)?
  • Nxinfected_confirm — How many of these infections have been confirmed with a positive test?
  • pos_test — Did you test positive before you developed long-term symptoms due to the coronavirus?
  • pos_test_first — Was this the first time you tested positive for the coronavirus?
  • pos_test_type — Which type of corona test determines this result?
  • pos_test_date — What date was this corona test? You can also estimate the date.
  • compl_date — On what date did the corona infection start before you had long-term symptoms? This is an infection that you think was caused by the coronavirus, whether or not it tested positive, and was the cause of your post-COVID symptoms. You can also estimate the date.
  • pc_confirmedby — Who told you you had long-COVID/post-COVID syndrome?
  • hosptial — Have you been admitted to hospital due to a corona infection before you developed long-term symptoms?
  • hospital_treat — Please check what applies to your hospital admission
  • hospital_start — On what date were you admitted to the hospital?_x000D_ You may also estimate the date.
  • hospital_end — What date were you discharged from the hospital?_x000D_ You may also estimate the date.
  • vaccin — Have you been vaccinated against the coronavirus?
  • vaccin_N — How many coronavirus vaccinations have you had?
  • vaccin_LTc_Nvacc — After how many corona vaccinations did the long-term complaints caused by the corona vaccine start?
  • vaccin_LTc_date — On what date did you get the vaccination that gave you post-COVID vaccination syndrome? If you don't remember exactly, you can estimate the date.
  • whodiagnosed — Who told you that you had/have post-COVID vaccination syndrome?
  • vaccin_LTc_Nvirus — How many vaccinations had you had before the long-term complaints caused by the coronavirus?
  • vaccin_LTc_other — Have you ever experienced long-term complaints after a vaccination? Other than a corona vaccination, for example after a travel vaccination or flu shot.
  • permission — Can we contact you for additional scientific research?
  • permission_pc — Consent form for post-COVID research
  • persmission_postvacc — Consent form for post-COVID vaccination complaints investigation
  • permission_pais — Consent form for research into other post-infectious conditions and chronic fatigue syndrome (ME/CFS)
  • permissions_check — You have not (yet) given permission on the previous page to be approached for additional research. Is this correct?
  • contact_pt — Enter your own contact details below
  • contact_GP — Enter your GP's contact details below.
  • travel — Are you able and willing to travel to participate in additional research?
  • contact — May we contact you for a telephone appointment or a video call for additional research?
  • preference — What type of research would you most like to participate in? We will try to take your preference into account, but you may also be invited to research that you have not selected below. Participation is of course always voluntary. You can select multiple options below. In biobank research, blood, urine and/or other materials from research participants are stored in order to be used for research at a later date.
  • newsletterportal — Can we send you a newsletter by email to keep you informed about research on postcovidonderzoek.nl and other relevant developments within the Post-COVID Network Netherlands?
  • fatigue_sev — How severe was your fatigue? Please indicate on a scale of 0 (not tired) to 10 (severely tired)
  • pain_sev — How severe were your pain complaints?_x000D_ Indicate on a scale of 0 (no pain complaints) to 10 (severe pain complaints)
  • concentration_sev — How serious were your complaints regarding concentration? Please indicate on a scale of 0 (no concentration problems) to 10 (severe concentration problems)
  • breathing_sev — How severe was your shortness of breath? Please indicate on a scale of 0 (not short of breath) to 10 (severely short of breath)
  • anxiety_history — Have you ever suffered from anxiety?
  • anxiety_treated — Have you been treated for these anxiety complaints?
  • depression_history — Have you ever suffered from depressive symptoms?
  • depression_treated — Have you been treated for these depressive complaints?
  • problem_list — What physical and/or psychological problems do you have? Please indicate which problems you have now or have had in the past 12 months (multiple answers possible).
  • diagnosis_formal — Do you have a formal diagnosis for one or more of the following conditions?
  • medicationuse — Are you currently taking any medications?
  • medicationlist — What are these medications? There are multiple possible answers.

Functioning & Daily Activities (27)

  • funcap_usetoilet — What are the consequences for you if you perform the activities described below? To what extent does this affect how much else you can do? Using the toilet (not bedpan or bedside commode)
  • funcap_shower — What are the consequences for you if you perform the activities described below? To what extent does this affect how much else you can do? Showering standing up
  • funcap_clothing — What are the consequences for you if you perform the activities described below? To what extent does this affect how much else you can do? Getting dressed in regular clothes
  • funcap_walkindoor — What are the consequences for you if you perform the activities described below? To what extent does this affect how much else you can do? Walking a short distance indoors, from one room to another
  • funcap_walkingdistance — What are the consequences for you if you perform the activities described below? To what extent does this affect how much else you can do? Walking between approx. 100 m and 1 km on level ground
  • funcap_activity — What are the consequences for you if you perform the activities described below? To what extent does this affect how much else you can do? Physical activity with increased heart rate, for approx. 15 min
  • funcap_sitbed — What are the consequences for you if you perform the activities described below? To what extent does this affect how much else you can do? Sitting in bed for approx. half an hour
  • funcap_sitchair — What are the consequences for you if you perform the activities described below? To what extent does this affect how much else you can do? Sitting in an upright chair with feet on floor for approx. 2 hours
  • funcap_standing — What are the consequences for you if you perform the activities described below? To what extent does this affect how much else you can do? Standing up for approx. 5 minutes, e.g. while queuing or while cooking
  • funcap_heavywork — What are the consequences for you if you perform the activities described below? To what extent does this affect how much else you can do? Heavier housework (washing floors, vacuuming etc.) for approx. half an hour continuously
  • funcap_cooking — What are the consequences for you if you perform the activities described below? To what extent does this affect how much else you can do? Cooking a complicated meal from scratch, approx. 1 hour
  • funcap_conversationshort — What are the consequences for you if you perform the activities described below? To what extent does this affect how much else you can do? Having a conversation for approx. 5 minutes
  • funcap_conversation30min — What are the consequences for you if you perform the activities described below? To what extent does this affect how much else you can do? Participating in a conversation with three people for approx. half an hour
  • funcap_social — What are the consequences for you if you perform the activities described below? To what extent does this affect how much else you can do? Participating in a dinner party, party or family event
  • funcap_outside — What are the consequences for you if you perform the activities described below? To what extent does this affect how much else you can do? Stepping right outside your home
  • funcap_shopping — What are the consequences for you if you perform the activities described below? To what extent does this affect how much else you can do? Going to a shop for groceries
  • funcap_transport — What are the consequences for you if you perform the activities described below? To what extent does this affect how much else you can do? Using public transport (bus or train)
  • funcap_participateactivity — What are the consequences for you if you perform the activities described below? To what extent does this affect how much else you can do? Participating in organized leisure activities such as classes or sports
  • funcap_lighting — What are the consequences for you if you perform the activities described below? To what extent does this affect how much else you can do? Staying in a room with normal lighting without sunglasses for approx. 1 hour
  • funcap_sunglasses — What are the consequences for you if you perform the activities described below? To what extent does this affect how much else you can do? Staying outdoors in daylight without sunglasses for approx. 2 hours
  • funcap_noise — What are the consequences for you if you perform the activities described below? To what extent does this affect how much else you can do? Staying in a noisy environment for approx. 1 hour
  • funcap_short_text — What are the consequences for you if you perform the activities described below? To what extent does this affect how much else you can do? Reading a short text, such as a mobile phone text message
  • funcap_officialdoc — What are the consequences for you if you perform the activities described below? To what extent does this affect how much else you can do? Reading and understanding a non-fiction text, such as an official document one A4 page long
  • funcap_media — What are the consequences for you if you perform the activities described below? To what extent does this affect how much else you can do? Using social media to stay in touch with others
  • funcap_shortfocus — What are the consequences for you if you perform the activities described below? To what extent does this affect how much else you can do? Focusing on a task for approx. 10 minutes continuously
  • funcap_longfocus — What are the consequences for you if you perform the activities described below? To what extent does this affect how much else you can do? Focusing on a task for approx. 2 hours continuously
  • funcap_workday — What are the consequences for you if you perform the activities described below? To what extent does this affect how much else you can do? Managing a full working day (non-physical work such as office work or classes)

Overstimulation (24)

  • MESSY_manypeople — Ik krijg last of ik voel mij overweldigd wanneer er veel mensen om mij heen zijn. Bijvoorbeeld: tijdens een familiefeest, in een treinstation, in een restaurant.
  • MESSY_headache — Ik krijg hoofdpijn als er veel omgevingsprikkels, zoals licht, geluid of geuren, om mij heen zijn. Bijvoorbeeld: tijdens een familiefeest, in een treinstation, in een restaurant.
  • MESSY_tired — Ik word moe als er veel omgevingsprikkels, zoals licht, geluid of geuren, om mij heen zijn. Bijvoorbeeld: tijdens een familiefeest, in een treinstation, in een restaurant.
  • MESSY_focus — Wanneer ik mij probeer te concentreren vind ik het moeilijk om niet afgeleid te raken door storende omgevingsprikkels. Bijvoorbeeld: wanneer ik een gesprek probeer te voeren, vind ik het moeilijk om niet afgeleid te raken door een televisie die aanstaat of door andere mensen die aan het praten zijn.
  • MESSY_hardwork — Ik heb het gevoel dat mijn brein te hard moet werken of mijn hoofd voelt zwaar wanneer ik omgevingsprikkels, zoals licht, geluid of geuren, moet verwerken.
  • MESSY_notquiet — Ik heb het gevoel dat mijn brein niet rustig of stil wordt.
  • MESSY_feverish — Ik krijg een ijl (koortsig) gevoel wanneer er veel omgevingsprikkels, zoals licht, geluid of geuren, om mij heen zijn. Bijvoorbeeld mijn zicht wordt wazig.
  • score_multisensory_sensitivity — Somscore multisensorische gevoeligheid
  • MESSY_visual — Bent u sinds het krijgen van long COVID gevoeliger geworden voor licht, felle kleuren of bewegende beelden? Bijvoorbeeld: snel bewegende beelden op de televisie, wanneer er mensen om u heen bewegen zoals in een drukke therapieruimte of in een restaurant
  • MESSY_visual1 — Hoe of wanneer merkte u dit?
  • MESSY_brightlight — Ik ben gevoelig voor fel licht. Bijvoorbeeld: fel zonlicht, het licht van een felle tl-buis.
  • MESSY_muchtosee — Ik krijg last of ik voel mij overweldigd wanneer er veel om mij heen te zien is. Bijvoorbeeld: wanneer er op de televisie beelden snel voorbij komen, in het verkeer, in een restaurant.
  • MESSY_distractseeing — Ik word afgeleid als er veel om mij heen te zien is. Bijvoorbeeld: wanneer ik een gesprek probeer te voeren in een druk restaurant, tijdens het rijden in de auto, in een supermarkt, wanneer er veel mensen in de buurt zijn.
  • MESSY_movement — Ik vind het vervelend wanneer er veel beweging om mij heen te zien is. Bijvoorbeeld: snel bewegende beelden op te televisie, voorbijkomend verkeer tijdens het rijden in de auto, mensen die zich om mij heen bewegen.
  • MESSY_brightcolour — Ik heb last van felle kleuren. Bijvoorbeeld: een felle kleur verf op de muur, fel gekleurde kleding
  • score_visual_sensitivity — Somscore visuele gevoeligheid
  • MESSY_auditory — Bent u sinds het krijgen van long COVID gevoeliger geworden voor geluid? Bijvoorbeeld: u ervaart geluiden als storend of hinderlijk die andere mensen niet als storend of hinderlijk ervaren.
  • MESSY_auditory1 — Hoe of wanneer merkte u dit?
  • MESSY_annoyed — Ik erger mij aan geluiden die voor andere mensen niet storend zijn. Bijvoorbeeld: verkeer dat langsrijdt, een telefoon die afgaat, een televisie of een radio die aanstaat, het geluid van spelende kinderen, mensen die eten.
  • MESSY_shutoff — Ik probeer geluid buiten te sluiten. Bijvoorbeeld: ik gebruik oordopjes of een koptelefoon, ik sluit mijn oren, ik zet de radio of de televisie zachter of uit
  • MESSY_avoid — Ik blijf weg van rumoerige situaties. Bijvoorbeeld een druk feest, een cafetaria, een treinstation.
  • MESSY_soundsens — Ik ben gevoelig voor geluid. Bijvoorbeeld ik ervaar geluiden als storend of hinderlijk die andere mensen niet als storend of hinderlijk ervaren.
  • MESSY_distractsound — Ik vind het moeilijk om mij te concentreren op een gesprek wanneer er om mij heen omgevingsgeluid is. Bijvoorbeeld ik raak afgeleid door een radio die aanstaat of door de gesprekken van andere mensen.
  • score_auditory_sensitivity — Somscore auditieve gevoeligheid

5. Legend

  • IRI — stable PCNN identifier for this column, based on variable_name_CBS. Do not change after use in data. These IRIs are minted in the files but are not yet registered at w3id.org, so they currently 404 in a browser.
  • exactMatch — same question, timeframe, scale and answer list. closeMatch — same topic, small differences. relatedMatch — related concept only. The field name on every variable is SKOS match.
  • Value set — shared answer list. The variable page links to it instead of repeating the table.
  • Instrument wording remains copyright of the original authors. This page publishes PCNN identifiers, English and Dutch labels, and SKOS matches.
